reference_engine.quantity: propellant mass flow at 3 kN (a priori eta_c* 0.90)

published 120 lb is Eureka-1; Eureka-2 had larger tanks and lighter structure

Eureka-2 was bought in 2023-24; whether its parts are in stock today says nothing about the rocket
